patch-mcp.note: Hosted Patch MCP server (Streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.1 with PKCE). On first connection the user verifies their US/Canadian phone number by text code and approves the connection; optional SMS consent is chosen separately in the UI. No API key to paste. Tools: get_phone_number, place_call, get_call, list_calls, end_call, send_text, get_text, list_texts, receive_texts. Texts and pictures go only to the authenticated user's own verified number, from the service messaging number. Only endpoint contacted by the plugin: https://www.patchmcp.com. Terms: https://www.patchmcp.com/terms
